title: Stir-Fried Squash with Crispy Fried Onions
description: A simple and delicious Chinese-inspired dish featuring stir-fried squash and crispy fried onions.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced squash and stir-fry until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the soy sauce and sugar, and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the crispy fried onions and stir-fry until well combined.
Serve hot and garnish with additional fried onions if desired.
Cook the squash over medium heat and check for doneness with a fork or knife.
Adjust the seasoning with soy sauce and sugar to taste.
Garnish with sesame seeds or chopped scallions if desired.
